notes: starters.byGen are the base starters, each checked as a Gen-matching, unevolved species with a 3-stage chain in chains.json. starters.lines is all 81 members of those 27 lines. extras are Pikachu (Yellow, Let's Go Pikachu) and Eevee (Let's Go Eevee), base forms only. spooky = all 65 species whose default form has the Ghost type in species.json, plus 40 curated non-Ghost extras (keys of spookyReasons). Regional forms are not counted, so the Ghost-typed regional forms (Alolan Marowak, Hisuian Zorua, Zoroark and Typhlosion, Galarian Corsola) do not add their species by type. Cubone/Marowak and Zorua/Zoroark are in the extras anyway. Corsola and Typhlosion are left out because their default forms do not look spooky. Left out of spooky on purpose: Drowzee/Hypno (Pokédex lore about luring children away), Mr. Mime and Jynx (unsettling or dated designs), Yveltal (death theme). Judgement calls kept in: Houndour/Houndoom (devil horns), Zorua/Zoroark (tricksters), Gothita line and Hatenna line (gothic and witch looks), Impidimp line (imps), Hoothoot/Noctowl (night owls). ultraBeasts = the 11 official Ultra Beasts (UB-01 to UB-05 plus Poipole/Naganadel, Stakataka, Blacephalon). Necrozma comes from Ultra Space but the games class it as a Legendary, not an Ultra Beast, so it is excluded. paradox = every species with genus 'Paradox Pokémon' in species.json: 20 with Protosynthesis or Quark Drive, including the Teal Mask/Indigo Disk/Mochi Mayhem additions (Walking Wake, Iron Leaves, Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, Iron Crown), plus Koraidon and Miraidon, whose in-game category is also Paradox Pokémon. Drop 1007 and 1008 if the round should exclude legendaries. fossils = the 15 species revived from fossils in the games plus their evolutions (25 total). Excluded and arguable: Genesect (Mythical, revived from a fossil in lore only), Relicanth (a living fossil, never revived). eeveelutions = the 8 Eevee evolutions. Eevee itself (133) is excluded here and lives in starters.extras; add it if the round wants the whole family. babies = species.json isBaby (19), matching the official baby list including Toxel. pseudoLegendary = full 3-stage lines whose final stage has a 600 base stat total: Dratini, Larvitar, Bagon, Beldum, Gible, Deino, Goomy, Jangmo-o, Dreepy, Frigibax. species.json has no base stats, so the 600 BST rule comes from known stats; line membership was checked against chains.json.
